arms.unit: Aggregate actual original strict evaluator executions on paired confirmation traces.
Aggregate actual incremental strict evaluator executions on the SAME paired confirmation traces.

extensions.controlled_followup.export_observation_unit: paired-confirmation evaluator aggregate; both share one physical supervisor/VM

row_semantics.auxiliary: Retain all six decoder-cell outcomes/costs, shared setup/common, calibration singles/original-only traces and host references as separate raw/nested artifacts and clearly scoped summaries.
row_semantics.backend_ref: Same actual allocated parent RUN for both rows.
row_semantics.flow: compute_flow counts logical evaluator observation rows, NOT VM runs or independent experiments. Physical invocation/VM identity/counts retained once in original supervisor/backend custody with explicit observation note.
row_semantics.instance_id: candidate-vm shared; one paired frozen population, not independent arm samples.
row_semantics.measurements: Each method only: actual retained paired-confirmation attempt/query counts, strict recovery/status/unique-target observations and primitive families. No calibration original-only traces in either paired total; no duplicated decoder/setup/common totals.
row_semantics.missing_work: Emit only an actually retained method observation. Zero/no-start and missing-arm work must retain shortfall/failure findings and absent rows; do not pad status rows/successes to obtain qualification. A partial observed arm can retain real counts with invalid/excluded status, never planned counts.
row_semantics.run_id: Observation ID deterministically derived from actual allocated supervisor parent, not a new ledger RUN or extra VM. Export schema permits nonempty string IDs; unique per method.
row_semantics.seed: harness_drawn actual shared public nonce when observed; no copying missing observations from planned values.
row_semantics.status: succeeded is completion/validation of the method observation, never scalar-recovery success. Zero recovered events is a valid recorded count. Record actual incomplete/error/exclusion separately.
row_semantics.strict_recovery: Original and incremental actual attempt status/scalar records; do not misattribute t1.e2 decoder success to original strict baseline.
row_semantics.worker: Same actual retained Sandbox identity for both rows; never synthesize a worker.

source_scope: Only run_postrun.py/test_postrun.py then both manifest metadata; no candidate evaluator/workload change.
